intro.title: Background presets collected on a single page.
intro.body: This view shows the reusable background utilities from the default theme, so you can compare shells, panels, glass layers, warm surfaces, and the app body backdrop in one place.

bodySample.title: The page-level body backdrop stays separate from widget surfaces.
bodySample.body: Use the body background for the application canvas and keep cards, shells, and glass panels on reusable surface presets.
bodySample.previewBody: This block renders the same backdrop function used by MuiCssBaseline for the application body.

header.title: Header
header.body: Sticky application chrome that sits above the page canvas and uses the app-glass treatment.
header.caption: Sticky app chrome

general.title: General surfaces for the app canvas and global layout chrome.
general.body: Use this group to inspect the body backdrop and the main application wrappers that appear across the whole site, including header and footer.

primary.title: Primary adaptive surfaces for shared containers.
primary.body: These mode-aware presets are the main flexible layers for floating containers, glass panels, and reusable chrome that should adapt between light and dark schemes.

secondary.title: Secondary adaptive surfaces for section inserts and quiet panels.
secondary.body: Use these tint presets for inner section panels, supportive inserts, and lighter emphasis blocks that should still adapt to the active color scheme.

special.title: Special fixed-tone surfaces for expressive sections and feature blocks.
special.body: These fixed-color presets are best for editorial shells, warm sections, and deliberate showcase surfaces where the tone should stay stable regardless of mode.

appGlass.title: App glass
appGlass.body: Sticky or floating chrome with blur and a restrained translucent fill.

panelDark.title: Dark panel
panelDark.body: Dense dark surface for hero-side cards and compact content panels.

shellDark.title: Dark shell
shellDark.body: High-contrast showcase surface for large editorial sections.

shellLight.title: Light shell
shellLight.body: Soft warm shell for bright feature blocks with illustration overlays.

tint.title: Tint
tint.body: Light gradient wash for quiet cards that need only a small lift from the page.

tintSoft.title: Tint soft
tintSoft.body: Even lighter version for helper panels and secondary informational blocks.

tintStrong.title: Tint strong
tintStrong.body: Brighter inner panel tint for contrast inside dark showcase shells.

glassSubtle.title: Glass subtle
glassSubtle.body: Low-opacity fill for stat rows and compact overlays on dark surfaces.

glass.title: Glass adaptive
glass.body: Mode-aware glass panel that works on both dark and light compositions.

glassLight.title: Glass light
glassLight.body: Bright translucent panel with blur, useful over light showcase art.

warm.title: Warm section
warm.body: Broad warm section background for release or news-style blocks.

warmMuted.title: Warm muted
warmMuted.body: Muted warm card surface that sits inside the broader warm section.

footer.title: Footer
footer.body: Deep footer backdrop with a more compact dark gradient than the main shells.
